name: Bess, Soul Nourisher
oracle_text:
Whenever one or more other creatures you control with base power and toughness 1/1 enter, put a +1/+1 counter on Bess.
Whenever Bess attacks, each other creature you control with base power and toughness 1/1 gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of +1/+1 counters on Bess.
blocked_sentences: Whenever one or more other creatures you control with base power and toughness 1/1 enter, put a +1/+1 counter on Bess.

needs.what: base_power / base_toughness accepted in a trigger filter (TRIGGER_FILTER_KEYS, read in triggers.matches_card_filter via characteristics._base_pt), so a batched permanent_enters trigger can match 'creatures you control with base power and toughness 1/1' per entering object
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The trigger filter's power/toughness read the LIVE value (Welcoming Vampire semantics), so a 1/1 token entering under an anthem or with a counter would be missed and a creature shrunk to 1/1 would wrongly count; base_power/base_toughness exist only in the effect selector and validate_trigger_filter refuses them. A trigger condition with exists over the subject binding only checks the first event of a batch, not 'one or more' of them
